headings: (200 G) ROSE ET PIVOINE SCENTED CANDLE

jsonld_raw.name: (200 G) ROSE ET PIVOINE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax, presented in a removable ceramic container.

Rose et Pivoine | A cloak of mystery dances in every drop of this creation. The warm, golden embrace of saffron, the majesty of oud, the luminous freshness of bergamot, and the ethereal whisper of sacred incense. A perfume that uplifts the soul, igniting an internal fire that illuminates the most memorable nights of celebration.

Notes:
Top: saffron, cumin.
Heart: guaiac wood, oud, cedar wood.
Base: musk, vetiver, incense.

Design featuring a decorative detail for the container crafted in travertine marble.
